reviews.author: Anthony O'Bryan
reviews.text:
I had a circuit in my house that would randomly cause multiple outlets to cease providing power. I stumbled upon Rick's listing and gave him a call. He was in the middle of a larger job, and didn't think he would be able to make it out to my house anytime soon, but unforeseen circumstances freed him up enough to tend to my issue.

Rick came out to my house, I explained the issue and what I had done to diagnose it (as a non-electrician home-owner), and he knew exactly what to do. He wasted no time, got straight to work, and had the issue fixed in short order. I asked him if he could replace another malfunctioning outlet I had just remembered about, and he replaced it as well in short order.

His price was very reasonable, and I couldn't be happier with the results. He has become my new go-to Electrician.

reviews.text: I bought a house, and after being screwed and paying way too much for things. I was given Ricks name and number. He came out and gave me a quote on what the other company did. Lo and behold he was so much cheaper, and did a better job than the other company would have done. I say that because the other company comes out throws stuff on and moves to the next customer. Rick comes out shows and tells you the truth of what needs to be done, makes sure everything is working properly, and while doing what I needed done. He did find a couple other problems and fixed them also. He also put up 5 lights I needed done, and sealed some places that needed sealed. He also cleans up his mess. You don’t find anyone to do that. Oh and some of the work the other company wanted to do DID NOT need done. They were just cushion their pockets.They wanted to charge me 3,000.00. Rick came out did more and didn’t charge me anything near that amount. I will definitely be hiring Rick for anything I need done for now on. He gets the job done, he’s thorough, he doesn’t rip people off, and he does what God wants him to do.

reviews.author: Chad Palmer
reviews.text: Rick came out and went over everything that we wanted to do. He gave me what seemed to be a very fair if not great estimate for the supplies and time needed to do the job. He was on time every time that we set up an appointment, and I have not had that same luck with any other company since moving here yet. No large timeframe window encompassing 4 hours leaving me taking off work to sit there just to get something rescheduled etc. He said a time and was here early both times. As far as the work goes he installed new outlets in my house, and multiple ones in my garage. He installed a couple lights as well. Also he changed the wiring in my house from a hard line into a 1970's stove to a 4 prong plug that I could plug our updated oven that had been sitting in our dinning room for months into. My wife is very happy about it trust me. He even tracked down what some ((random) switch was for in our attic that I had no idea was to for nothing. Courteous, clean and just a completely happy experience. FYI I don't normally give out reviews but this was totally worth taking the time to write. Thanks again and if I ever need anymore work done I know who to call.
